summary: First backend testing pass for AI Office Platform Phase 1. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering health, auth, industries, countries, tenant onboarding + CRUD (services/customers/leads/appointments/knowledge), tenant isolation, admin RBAC, feature flag toggle, country admin override, public business page, Stripe plans/checkout/status, and advisor chat. All 30 tests PASSED against the public preview URL. Advisor used LLM fallback path (acceptable per spec). Public tenant 'office-engine' was present (status 200) and returned the expected public shape.

minor.issue: Returns the user doc but still includes `tenant_id` and omits `password_hash`; however response does not clearly indicate email verification requirement. Consider wrapping in {user, tenant} envelope for frontend clarity.
Not auth-protected — anyone with a session_id can read tx status. Low risk but consider require_tenant_user and tenant_id check.
Prints reset link to stdout only (expected for Phase 1), no email transport. Document for future phase.

critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY falls back to 'sk_test_emergent' if env missing — in prod this would silently fail. Consider raising on startup if missing in production mode.
payments.py GET /payments/status/{session_id} is unauthenticated. Add auth + tenant_id validation to avoid tx enumeration.

auth.py register: slugify logic strips non-alnum into '-' then truncates to 40 chars BEFORE stripping trailing '-'; could produce empty slug if business_name is pure punctuation (handled by fallback). Minor edge case.
tenants.py onboard: re-running onboarding would re-seed services/knowledge (no dedupe). Idempotency not guaranteed.

server.py registers CORSMiddleware AFTER include_router; FastAPI/Starlette normally expects middleware added before routes. In practice it still works because CORS runs at ASGI layer, but convention is reversed. Also allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject '*' + credentials; the regex works but is permissive. OK for preview, tighten in prod.
models.py Tenant.contact_email typed as `str` while TenantOnboardingIn uses EmailStr — mild type drift (intentionally normalized to str via model code).
No rate limiting on /api/advisor/chat — susceptible to abuse of LLM quota.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates ~2 TEST_ prefixed tenants + a few TEST_ services/customers/leads/appointments/knowledge entries. Services/customers/appts/knowledge test items are cleaned up; owner tenants and residual lead rows remain (prefixed with TEST_ for easy identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and is parallel-safe (2 workers). Uses pytest.Session cookie jars for admin and two independent tenant owners (owner_session_a/b). Any new routes should be added to this suite. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is used as BASE_URL. Public tenant 'office-engine' exists and is active.
